title: Distance Profile Embedding for Independence and Conditional Independence Testing of Random Objects
summary: Testing independence or conditional independence is fundamental to statistical inference, yet existing methods for non-Euclidean random objects often face a difficult trade-off between geometric flexibility and theoretical tractability. We introduce the Distance Profile Embedding (DPE), a novel representation that maps random objects from general metric spaces into a Hilbert space of square-integrable functions. We prove that this mapping is injective and preserves full distributional information without requiring isometric Hilbert embeddings or one-to-one correspondence conditions.…
